change: On opt-in R13/R14 reads, retain bounded CRC-checked BLOCK_HEADER frames directly from reader-authenticated source offsets, using an independent cursor. The CLI adapter retains a maximum of 10000 frames, 64 KiB per frame and 16 MiB total including an overhead allowance; a capture failure clears the set and disables further capture without failing the drawing read. Every new import attempt invalidates the prior set.

validation.sourceChecks: For both generated resaved samples, captured handles, physical source offsets, unique ordinals, version and import generation match the retained block records; an independent file read through the validated frame reader returns identical body bytes. Changing stored bytes or generation is detected; restoring them succeeds.
validation.failureRetry: An injected capture failure clears evidence and disables further collection while the drawing read succeeds; switching the same adapter back to normal and importing again captures the frames. A missing-file re-import clears prior evidence, and a corrected same-adapter import succeeds.
validation.reproduction: Generate and resave locally using tools/research/generate_acadrust_legacy_shape.py; configure LIBDXFRW_AC1012_LAYOUT_WIRE_SAMPLE and LIBDXFRW_AC1014_LAYOUT_WIRE_SAMPLE, then run the external layout graph CTests.
validation.asan: Fully instrumented reader, CLI and adapter pass both generated legacy graph/capture, failure and retry tests under AddressSanitizer.

limits: Frames are provisional and are not yet decoded or bound to the live BLOCK_HEADER body by an independent observer.
No output support claim is promoted; legacy layout projection and dictionary merge semantics remain gated.
The corpus consists of generated peer controls, not native AutoCAD files, and no DWG or DXF was committed.
